type Config struct
field Config.Address string
field Config.Dialer *net.Dialer
field Config.Network string
field Config.Reconnect ReconnectPolicy
field Config.SessionConfig session.Config
field Config.TLSConfig *tls.Config
func Dial(ctx context.Context, config Config) (*Client, error)
var ErrUnavailable error
type MetricsSnapshot struct

field MetricsSnapshot.Reconnects uint64
func New(conn net.Conn, config session.Config) (*Client, error)
type ReconnectPolicy struct
field ReconnectPolicy.BindTimeout time.Duration
field ReconnectPolicy.Enabled bool
field ReconnectPolicy.InitialBackoff time.Duration
field ReconnectPolicy.MaxBackoff time.Duration
field ReconnectPolicy.Multiplier float64
type UnavailableError struct
field UnavailableError.Cause error
field UnavailableError.Reconnecting bool
method (*UnavailableError).Error() string
